title: Why spaghetti never snaps in two
pause_note: Shorts v4: DO + WEIRD hook (three pieces at 1.5 s), slow-motion reveal at 7-10 s, loop ending

beats: Try to snap a dry spaghetti strand in two.
You almost never can. It usually breaks into three or more.
In slow motion, the first break makes the pieces snap back.
That sends a bending wave down the strand, and it breaks again.
Researchers at MIT found a fix. Twist it almost a full turn first.
Then bend it slowly. Now it usually snaps in two.
It takes a few tries. Try it tonight.
